grimdark-future.AP: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.
grimdark-future.Agile: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.
grimdark-future.Aircraft: May only use Advance actions, moving in a straight line, and adding 30" to its total move (even if Shaken). Aircraft ignore all units and terrain when moving and stopping, can't seize or contest objectives, can't be charged, and units targeting them get -12" range and -1 to hit rolls.
grimdark-future.Ambush: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9" away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can't seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.
grimdark-future.Ambush Aura: This model and its unit get Ambush.
grimdark-future.Ambush Beacon: Friendly units using Ambush may ignore distance restrictions from enemies if they are deployed within 6" of this model.
grimdark-future.Ambush Re-Deployment: Once per game, when a unit where all models have this rule ends its activation, you may immediately remove it from the table (dropping any objectives it might hold within 1"), and deploy it as if it had Ambush at the beginning of the next round.
grimdark-future.Ambushing Piercing Shot: Counts as having Ambush, and its weapons get AP(+1) when shooting on the round in which it deploys via this rule.
grimdark-future.Anti-Cover Aura: This model and its unit get Anti-Cover on its weapons when shooting.
grimdark-future.Anti-Cover when Shooting: This model gets Anti-Cover on its weapons when shooting.
grimdark-future.Anti-Cover when Shooting Aura: This model and its unit get Anti-Cover on its weapons when shooting.
grimdark-future.Artillery: When this model uses Hold actions and shoots at enemies over 12" away, it gets +1 to hit rolls. If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they haven't moved during this round, enemy units shooting at them from over 12" away get -1 to hit rolls.
grimdark-future.Assault: Counts as both a ranged weapon and a melee weapon.
grimdark-future.Bad Shot: This model gets -1 to hit rolls when shooting.
grimdark-future.Bane: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.
grimdark-future.Bane Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Bane on their weapons when attacking against once (next time the effect would apply).
grimdark-future.Bane in Melee Aura: This model and its unit get Bane on its weapons in melee.
grimdark-future.Bane in Melee Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Bane on its weapons in melee once (next time the effect would apply).
grimdark-future.Bane when Shooting: This model gets Bane on its weapons when shooting.
grimdark-future.Bane when Shooting Aura: This model and its unit get Bane on its weapons when shooting.
grimdark-future.Banner: This model and its unit get +1 to Morale Test rolls triggered by shooting/melee.
grimdark-future.Battleborn: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.
grimdark-future.Berserker: Once per game, the Hero and its unit may ignore becoming Fatigued.
grimdark-future.Blast: Ignores Cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X, where X is up to as many hits as models in the target unit.
grimdark-future.Blinded: Gets -1 to hit rolls when using move actions and shooting.
grimdark-future.Bloodborn: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn't apply to newly generated attacks.
grimdark-future.Bounding: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".
grimdark-future.Bounding Aura: This model and its unit get Bounding.
grimdark-future.Brace: Enemies charging this unit get -X total Impact rolls, unless this unit is Fatigued.
grimdark-future.Bravery Aura: This model and its unit get +1 to Morale Test rolls.
grimdark-future.Bravery Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to Morale Test rolls once (next time the effect would apply).
grimdark-future.Brutal: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).
grimdark-future.Caster: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can't have more than 6 at once. Once per activation, before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell's value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Pick a target and roll one die, and on 4+ resolve the spell's effect. Models within 18" of the Caster may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling to give the Caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.
grimdark-future.Caster Group: Pick one model with this rule in this unit to have Caster(X), where X is the total number of models with this rule in this unit. If the model is killed, pick another to be the new caster, and transfer all spell tokens to it. The caster loses all unspent spell tokens at the end of the round.
grimdark-future.Casting Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 12" with Caster, which gets +1 to casting rolls once (next time the effect would apply).
grimdark-future.Changebound: If most models in this unit have this rule, enemy units shooting/charging them from over 9"/6" away get -1 to hit rolls .

age-of-fantasy.Mischievous: When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons.
age-of-fantasy.Morale Debuff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to Morale Test rolls once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Motivated: Gets +1 to rolls when taking Morale Tests.
age-of-fantasy.Motivator: The Hero and its unit get +1 to Morale Test rolls triggered by shooting.
age-of-fantasy.Musician: This model and its unit moves +1" when using move actions.
age-of-fantasy.Nimble: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3".
age-of-fantasy.No Retreat: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored.
age-of-fantasy.No Retreat Aura: This model and its unit get No Retreat.
age-of-fantasy.Obliterate: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Tough(3) or higher, the target must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6.
age-of-fantasy.Ossified: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).
age-of-fantasy.Parry: When this unit takes hits in melee, roll X dice per model with this rule in it, up to as many dice as hits taken. For each 6+ one hit is ignored (defender picks which).
age-of-fantasy.Pierce: Ignores all positive Defense modifiers on the target, and when attacking units over half of this weapon's range away, this weapon gets AP(+1).
age-of-fantasy.Piercing Charge: This model gets AP(+1) on its weapons when charging.
age-of-fantasy.Piercing Charge Aura: This model and its unit get Piercing Charge.
age-of-fantasy.Piercing Charge Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Piercing Charge once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Piercing Feat: Once per game, when this unit attacks, you may use this rule so that the weapons of all models with this rule in it get AP(+1).
age-of-fantasy.Piercing Fighter: This model gets AP(+1) on its weapons in melee.
age-of-fantasy.Piercing Fighter Aura: This model and its unit get AP(+1) on its weapons in melee.
age-of-fantasy.Piercing Fighting Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets AP(+1) on their weapons in melee against once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Piercing Frenzy: Place one token on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of two tokens. For each token all models with this rule in this unit get AP(+1) on their weapons when attacking until the end of the game.
age-of-fantasy.Piercing Marksman: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model's weapons get AP(+1).
age-of-fantasy.Piercing Marksman Aura: This model and its unit get Piercing Marksman.
age-of-fantasy.Piercing Shooter Aura: This model and its unit get AP(+1) on its weapons when shooting.
age-of-fantasy.Piercing Spotter: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 30" and in line of sight of this model and roll one die, on a 4+ place a token on it. When attacking, friendly units may remove tokens from their target before rolling to block to get +AP(X) on their weapons, where X is the number of removed tokens.
age-of-fantasy.Piercing Tag: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, place X tokens on one enemy unit within 24" and in line of sight, or one token on X enemy units within 24" and in line of sight. When attacking, friendly units may remove one token from their target before rolling to block to get AP(+1) on their weapons.
age-of-fantasy.Piercing Target: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, pick X enemy units within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place one token on them. Friendly units get AP(+1) on their weapons when attacking them.
age-of-fantasy.Piercing Warrior: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, its weapons get AP(+1).
age-of-fantasy.Plaguebound: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored.
age-of-fantasy.Precision Attacks Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to hit rolls when attacking once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Precision Charge: This model gets +1 to hit rolls when charging.
age-of-fantasy.Precision Charge Aura: This model and its unit get +1 to hit rolls when charging.
age-of-fantasy.Precision Debuff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to hit rolls when attacking once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Precision Feat: Once per game, when this unit attacks, you may use this rule so that all models with this rule in it get +1 to hit rolls.
age-of-fantasy.Precision Fighter Aura: This model and its unit get +1 to hit rolls in melee.
age-of-fantasy.Precision Fighter Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to hit rolls in melee once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Precision Fighting Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +1 to hit rolls in melee against once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Precision Frenzy: Place one token on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of two tokens. For each token all models with this rule in this unit get +1 to hit rolls until the end of the game.
age-of-fantasy.Precision Growth: Place one token on this unit at the beginning of each round if it's on the table and isn't Shaken, up to a max. of four tokens. For every two tokens, models with this rule in this unit get +1 to hit rolls.
age-of-fantasy.Precision Marksman: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model gets +1 to hit rolls.
age-of-fantasy.Precision Shooter Aura: This model and its unit get +1 to hit rolls when shooting.
age-of-fantasy.Precision Shooter Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to hit rolls when shooting once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Precision Shooting Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +1 to hit rolls when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Precision Spotter: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 30" and in line of sight of this model and roll one die, on a 4+ place a token on it. Friendly units may remove tokens from their target before rolling to hit to get +X to hit rolls when attacking, where X is the number of removed tokens.
age-of-fantasy.Precision Tag: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, place X tokens on one enemy unit within 24" and in line of sight, or one token on X enemy units within 24" and in line of sight. When attacking, friendly units may remove one token from their target before rolling to hit to get +1 to hit rolls.
age-of-fantasy.Precision Target: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, pick X enemy units within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place one token on them. Friendly units get +1 to hit rolls when attacking them.
age-of-fantasy.Predator: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn't apply to newly generated attacks.
age-of-fantasy.Predator Fighter: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit in melee, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn't apply to newly generated attacks.
age-of-fantasy.Primal: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn't apply to newly generated attacks.
age-of-fantasy.Protected: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored.
age-of-fantasy.Protection Feat: Once per game, when this unit takes wounds and most of its models have this rule, you may use this rule and roll one die per wound, and on a 5+ it is ignored.
age-of-fantasy.Prowler: The Hero and its unit move +1" on Advance actions.
age-of-fantasy.Puncture: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Defense 2+ to Defense 3+, this weapon gets AP(+2).
age-of-fantasy.Purge: When attacking units that are Shaken or Fatigued, this weapon gets AP(+2).
age-of-fantasy.Quick: Moves +2" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.
age-of-fantasy.Quick Shot: This model may shoot after using Rush actions.
age-of-fantasy.Quick Shot Aura: This model and its unit get Quick Shot.
age-of-fantasy.Quick Shot Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Quick Shot against once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Quick Throw: This model may always target enemies that are not in line of sight when shooting with Indirect weapons (instead of only when using Hold actions).
age-of-fantasy.Ranged Shrouding: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting, that enemy unit gets -4" range to a min. of 6".
age-of-fantasy.Ranged Shrouding Aura: This model and its unit get Ranged Shrouding.
age-of-fantasy.Ranged Slayer: When using Hold actions and shooting, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher.
age-of-fantasy.Ranged Slayer Aura: This model and its unit get Ranged Slayer.
age-of-fantasy.Rapid Advance: This model moves +4" when using Advance actions.
age-of-fantasy.Rapid Advance Aura: This model and its unit get Rapid Advance.
age-of-fantasy.Rapid Charge: This model moves +4" when using Charge actions.
age-of-fantasy.Rapid Charge Aura: This model and its unit moves +4" when using Charge actions.
age-of-fantasy.Rapid Charge Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Rapid Charge against once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Rapid Rush: This model moves +6" when using Rush actions.
age-of-fantasy.Rapid Rush Aura: This model and its unit get Rapid Rush.
age-of-fantasy.Rapid Rush Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Rapid Rush once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Ravage: Once per round, when it's this model's turn to strike in melee, roll X dice before attacking, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.
age-of-fantasy.Ravage Aura: This model and its unit get Ravage(+1).
age-of-fantasy.Re-Deployment: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next.
age-of-fantasy.Reanimation: When a unit where all models have this rule is activated, roll as many dice as the max. number of models/wounds it could restore. For each 5+ you may restore one model/wound. Note that new models may only be restored if they can be placed in coherency with non-restored models.
age-of-fantasy.Reanimation Aura: This model and its unit get Reanimation.
age-of-fantasy.Reap: When attacking units that are Shaken or Fatigued, the target must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6.
age-of-fantasy.Reckless Piercing: When a unit where most models have this rule is activated, you may roll one die. On a 2+ their weapons get AP(+1) when attacking until the end of the round, but on a 1 enemy units get AP(+1) on their weapons when attacking them instead.
age-of-fantasy.Reckless Piercing Aura: This model and its unit get Reckless Piercing.
age-of-fantasy.Regeneration: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.
age-of-fantasy.Regeneration Aura: This model and its unit get Regeneration.
age-of-fantasy.Regeneration Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Regeneration once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Regenerative Strength: Place one token on this model when it ignores a wound. Once per round, when it's this model's turn to strike in melee, roll as many dice as tokens on it before attacking, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 4+ the target takes one wound.
age-of-fantasy.Reinforcement: When a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken, you may remove it from the table as destroyed. At the beginning of the next round after a unit where all models have this rule is destroyed, after Ambushers have been deployed, you may place a new copy of it fully within 9" of any table edge, over 9" away from enemy units. Units that deploy via Reinforcement can't seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy, and this rule doesn't apply to the new copy of the unit.
age-of-fantasy.Relentless: When this model shoots at enemies over 9" away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).
age-of-fantasy.Relentless Aura: This model and its unit get Relentless.
age-of-fantasy.Relentless Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Relentless against once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Rending: Ignores Regeneration, and for each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+4).
age-of-fantasy.Rending Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Rending on their weapons against once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Rending in Melee: This model gets Rending on its weapons in melee.
age-of-fantasy.Rending in Melee Aura: This model and its unit get Rending on its weapons in melee.
age-of-fantasy.Rending when Shooting Aura: This model and its unit get Rending on its weapons when shooting.
age-of-fantasy.Repel Ambushers: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.
age-of-fantasy.Resilient: Gets +1 to Defense rolls when blocking hits.
age-of-fantasy.Retaliate: When this model takes wounds in melee, the attacker takes X hits per wound taken.
age-of-fantasy.Retreating Strike: Once per round, when this unit ends its move within 3" of enemy units after being in melee, pick one of them and roll X dice for each model with this rule in this unit. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.
age-of-fantasy.Royal Legion: This model gets +4"/+2" range when shooting/charging.
age-of-fantasy.Royal Warrior: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn't apply to newly generated attacks.
age-of-fantasy.Runner: The Hero and its unit move +2" on Rush/Charge actions.
age-of-fantasy.Scourge: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, enemies count as having taken 2 extra wounds when checking who won melee, or if shooting wounds would trigger Morale Tests.
age-of-fantasy.Scout: May be set aside before deployment. After all other units are deployed, may be deployed anywhere fully within 9" of their deployment zone, over 9" away from non-Scout enemy units. Players alternate in placing Scout units, starting with the player that activates next.
age-of-fantasy.Scout Aura: This model and its unit get Scout.
age-of-fantasy.Screened: If most models in this unit have this rule, enemy units shooting/charging them from over 9"/6" away get -1 to hit rolls .
age-of-fantasy.Scurry: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.
age-of-fantasy.Sergeant: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.
age-of-fantasy.Shadowborn: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting/charging, that enemy unit gets -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6".
age-of-fantasy.Sharpshooter: Once per game, the Hero and its unit get +12" range when shooting.
age-of-fantasy.Shatter: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+3).
age-of-fantasy.Shielded: Units where most models have this rule get +1 to Defense rolls against hits that are not from spells.
age-of-fantasy.Shielded Aura: This model and its unit get Shielded.
age-of-fantasy.Shred: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.
age-of-fantasy.Shred Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Shred on their weapons when attacking against once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Shred in Melee Aura: This model and its unit get Shred on its weapons in melee.
age-of-fantasy.Shred when Shooting Aura: This model and its unit get Shred on its weapons when shooting.
age-of-fantasy.Shrouded: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting/charging, that enemy unit gets -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6".
age-of-fantasy.Slayer: When using Hold actions and shooting, or when charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher.
age-of-fantasy.Slayer Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Slayer against once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Slow: Moves -2" when using Advance, and -4" when using Rush/Charge.
age-of-fantasy.Smash: When attacking units over half of this weapon's range away, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.
age-of-fantasy.Spawn: Once per game, when this model is activated, you may place a new unit of X fully within 6" of it. Units placed via Spawn can't seize or contest objectives on the round they are placed.
age-of-fantasy.Specialist: Gets +1 to hit rolls when in melee or when shooting (pick one).
age-of-fantasy.Speed Debuff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy model within 18" in line of sight, which moves -2" when using Advance actions and -4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Speed Feat: Once per game, when this unit moves, you may use this rule so that all models with this rule in it move +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions.
age-of-fantasy.Speed Feat Aura: This model and its unit get Speed Feat.
age-of-fantasy.Spell Accumulator: Gets X accumulator tokens at the start of each round, but can't hold more than 6 tokens at once. Casters from other friendly units within 12" may spend this model's accumulator tokens as if they were their own spell tokens. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.
age-of-fantasy.Spell Conduit: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.
age-of-fantasy.Spell Drain: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy model within 18" in line of sight, which must take a Morale Test. If failed, it loses 2 spell tokens.
age-of-fantasy.Spell Resistance: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. If the wound was from a spell, then it is ignored on a 2+. If the wound was not from a spell, then it is ignored on a 6+ instead.
age-of-fantasy.Spell Resistance Aura: This model and its unit get Spell Resistance.
age-of-fantasy.Split: When this unit is fully destroyed, you may place a new unit of X fully within 6" of it before removing the last model. Units placed via Split can't seize or contest objectives on the round they are placed.
age-of-fantasy.Steadfast: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.
age-of-fantasy.Steadfast Aura: This model and its unit get Steadfast.
age-of-fantasy.Stealth: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.
age-of-fantasy.Stealth Aura: This model and its unit get Stealth.
age-of-fantasy.Stealth Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Stealth once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Strategist: Once per game, the Hero and its unit may re-roll one roll of any kind when shooting.
age-of-fantasy.Strider: May ignore the effects of Difficult terrain.
age-of-fantasy.Strider Aura: This model and its unit get Strider.
age-of-fantasy.Sturdy: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Defense rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.
age-of-fantasy.Suppressor: The Hero and its unit get AP(+1) when using Hold and shooting.
age-of-fantasy.Surge: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).
age-of-fantasy.Surge Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Surge on their weapons when attacking against once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Surprise Attack: Counts as having Infiltrate. The first time this unit is activated, pick one enemy unit within 6" in line of sight, and roll X dice. For each 2+ it takes one hit with AP(1).
age-of-fantasy.Swift: This model may ignore the Slow rule.
age-of-fantasy.Swift Aura: This model and its unit get Swift.
age-of-fantasy.Tactician: Once per game, the Hero and its unit may re-roll one roll of any kind in melee.
age-of-fantasy.Takedown: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target for this weapon's attacks, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.
age-of-fantasy.Takedown Strike: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to strike in melee, it may make X attacks at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.
age-of-fantasy.Takedown when Shooting: This model gets Takedown on its weapons when shooting.
age-of-fantasy.Teleport: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions.
age-of-fantasy.Teleport Aura: This model and its unit get Teleport.
age-of-fantasy.Thrust: When charging, gets +1 to hit rolls and AP(+1) in melee.
age-of-fantasy.Thrust in Melee Aura: This model and its unit get Thrust on its weapons in melee.
age-of-fantasy.Tough: This model must take X wounds before being killed. If a model with Tough joins a unit without it, then it is removed last when the unit takes wounds. You must continue to put wounds on the Tough model with most wounds in the unit until it is killed, before starting to put them on the next Tough model (Heroes must be assigned wounds last, even if already wounded).
age-of-fantasy.Transport: May transport up to X friendly models or Heroes with up to Tough(6), and non-Heroes with up to Tough(3) which occupy 3 spaces each. Transports may deploy with units inside, and units may enter/exit by using any move action, getting within 2" to enter, and staying fully within 6" when exiting. Units inside/outside transports may not target other units that are outside/inside, but may target the transport itself. When a transport is destroyed, units inside must take a Dangerous Terrain Test, are Shaken, and must be placed fully within 6" of the transport before it's removed.
age-of-fantasy.Traversal: May move through friendly and enemy units.
age-of-fantasy.Unique Hero: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.
age-of-fantasy.Unmovable: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.
age-of-fantasy.Unpredictable: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.
age-of-fantasy.Unpredictable Fighter: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.
age-of-fantasy.Unpredictable Fighter Aura: This model and its unit get Unpredictable Fighter.
age-of-fantasy.Unpredictable Fighter Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unpredictable Fighter against once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Unpredictable Shooter: When shooting, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.
age-of-fantasy.Unpredictable Shooter Aura: This model and its unit get Unpredictable Shooter.
age-of-fantasy.Unstoppable: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.
age-of-fantasy.Unstoppable Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unstoppable on their weapons against once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Unstoppable in Melee: This model gets Unstoppable on its weapons in melee.
age-of-fantasy.Unstoppable in Melee Aura: This model and its unit get Unstoppable on its weapons in melee.
age-of-fantasy.Unstoppable when Shooting Aura: This model and its unit get Unstoppable on its weapons when shooting.
age-of-fantasy.Unwieldy Debuff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets Unwieldy on its weapons in melee once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Vale Oath: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.
age-of-fantasy.Valiant: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Morale Test rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.
age-of-fantasy.Vanguard: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.
age-of-fantasy.Vengeance: When this unit is fully destroyed, place as many Vengeance tokens on the unit that destroyed it as models with this rule in this unit at the beginning of the game. Friendly units get +X to hit rolls when attacking that unit, where X is the number of tokens on it.
age-of-fantasy.Versatile Defense: When a unit where most models have this rule is shot/charged from over 9"/6" away, pick one effect: the unit either gets +1 to Defense rolls, or enemy units get -1 to hit rolls against it. Note that you may pick a different effect each time the unit is attacked.
age-of-fantasy.Versatile Defense Aura: This model and its unit get Versatile Defense.
age-of-fantasy.Versatile Expert: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) when attacking, or get +1 to hit rolls when attacking.
age-of-fantasy.Versatile Reach: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, all models with this rule in this unit either get +4" range when shooting or move +2" when charging.
age-of-fantasy.Versatile Warrior: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away, all models with this rule in it either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls.
age-of-fantasy.Versatile Warrior Aura: This model and its unit get Versatile Warrior.
age-of-fantasy.Versatile Warrior Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Versatile Warrior once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy.Vicious: When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons.
age-of-fantasy.Vigilant: Gets +1 to hit rolls when shooting.
age-of-fantasy.Vinci Tech: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away, all models with this rule in it either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls.
age-of-fantasy.Violent: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified results of 1 to block hits from weapons deal 1 extra wound.
age-of-fantasy.Warbound: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified results of 1 to block hits from weapons deal 1 extra wound.
age-of-fantasy.Warden: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).
age-of-fantasy.Warding: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. If the wound was from a spell, then it is ignored on a 2+. If the wound was not from a spell, and the unit was shot/charged from over 9"/6" away, then it is ignored on a 6+ instead.
age-of-fantasy.Wave-Step: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3".
age-of-fantasy.Weakened: Gets -1 to Defense rolls when blocking hits.
age-of-fantasy.Wild Veil: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting/charging, that enemy unit gets -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6".

age-of-fantasy-skirmish.AP: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Agile: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Aircraft: May only use Advance actions, moving in a straight line, and adding 30" to its total move (even if Shaken). Aircraft ignore all units and terrain when moving and stopping, can't seize or contest objectives, can't be charged, and units targeting them get -12" range and -1 to hit rolls.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Ambush: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9" away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can't seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Ambush Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ambush. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Ambush Re-Deployment: Once per game, when a unit where all models have this rule ends its activation, you may immediately remove it from the table (dropping any objectives it might hold within 1"), and deploy it as if it had Ambush at the beginning of the next round.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Angelic Blessing: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. If the wound was from a spell, then it is ignored on a 2+. If the wound was not from a spell, and the unit was shot/charged from over 9"/6" away, then it is ignored on a 6+ instead.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Artillery: When this model uses Hold actions and shoots at enemies over 12" away, it gets +1 to hit rolls. If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they haven't moved during this round, enemy units shooting at them from over 12" away get -1 to hit rolls.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Assault: Counts as both a ranged weapon and a melee weapon.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Bane: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Bane in Melee: This model gets Bane on its weapons in melee.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Bane in Melee Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bane on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Bane when Shooting: This model gets Bane on its weapons when shooting.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Bane when Shooting Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bane on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Banner: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to Morale Test rolls triggered by shooting/melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Battle-Hardened: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Morale Test rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Berserker: Once per game, the Hero may ignore becoming Fatigued.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Bestial: When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Blast: Ignores Cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X. Hits must be split evenly between the target and all enemy units within 3" of any model from the target (defender picks how), but each unit may only take up to as many hits as models in it
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Blinded: Gets -1 to hit rolls when using move actions and shooting.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Bloodthirsty Fighter: For each unmodified roll of 1 that enemies roll when blocking hits from this model's weapons in melee, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn't apply to newly generated attacks.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Bounding: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Bounding Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bounding. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Brace: Enemies charging this unit get -X total Impact rolls, unless this unit is Fatigued.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Brace in Melee: This model gets Brace(1) on its weapons in melee.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Bravery Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to Morale Test rolls. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Brutal: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Brute Courage: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Buccaneer: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model gets +1 to hit rolls.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Caster: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can't have more than 6 at once. Once per activation, before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell's value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Pick a target and roll one die, and on 4+ resolve the spell's effect. Models within 18" of the Caster may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling to give the Caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Caster Group: This model counts as having Caster(1).
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Changebound: If most models in this unit have this rule, enemy units shooting/charging them from over 9"/6" away get -1 to hit rolls .
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Chemist: The Hero gets +1 to Defense rolls when shot.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Coordinate: At the end of this unit's activation, another friendly unit within 12" that hasn't activated yet may be activated immediately. May not be used if this unit was activated via Coordinate.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Counter: May strike first with this weapon when charged, unless this unit is Fatigued.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Counter in Melee: This model gets Counter on its weapons in melee.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Counter in Melee Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Counter on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Counter-Attack: May strike first when charged, unless this unit is Fatigued.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Crazed: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn't apply to newly generated attacks.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Crippled: Moves -1" on Advance and -2" on Rush/Charge actions.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Crossing Attack: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Crossing Strike: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and attack it with this weapon as if it was shooting. This weapon may only be used in this way.

age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Dangerous Terrain Debuff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Dangerous terrain once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Dead: Remove the Hero from your warband sheet.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Deadly: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don't carry over to other models if the original target is killed.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Deathstrike: If this model is killed in melee, the attacking unit takes X hits.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Decimate: When attacking units with more than half of their total size or Tough value (for single-model units), the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Defense: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Defense Debuff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to Defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Defensive Frenzy: If most models in this unit have this rule, place one token on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of two tokens. For each token this unit gets +1 to Defense rolls until the end of the game.

age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Duellist: The Hero gets AP(+1) in melee when charged.

age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Reckless Piercing Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Reckless Piercing. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Regeneration: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Regeneration Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Regeneration. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Reinforcement: When a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken, you may remove it from the table as destroyed. At the beginning of the next round after a unit where all models have this rule is destroyed, after Ambushers have been deployed, you may place a new copy of it fully within 9" of any table edge, over 9" away from enemy units. Units that deploy via Reinforcement can't seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy, and this rule doesn't apply to the new copy of the unit.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Relentless: When this model shoots at enemies over 9" away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Relentless Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Relentless. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Relentless Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Relentless against once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Reliable when Shooting: This model gets Reliable on its weapons when shooting.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Rending: Ignores Regeneration, and for each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+4).
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Rending in Melee: This model gets Rending on its weapons in melee.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Rending in Melee Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Rending on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Rending when Shooting Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Rending on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Repel Ambushers: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Resilient: Gets +1 to Defense rolls when blocking hits.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Retaliate: When this model takes wounds in melee, the attacker takes X hits per wound taken.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Retreating Strike: Once per round, when this unit ends its move within 3" of enemy units after being in melee, pick one of them and roll X dice for each model with this rule in this unit. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Royal Legion: This model gets +4"/+2" range when shooting/charging.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Royal Warrior: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn't apply to newly generated attacks.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Runner: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Savage: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Scourge: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, enemies count as having taken 2 extra wounds when checking who won melee, or if shooting wounds would trigger Morale Tests.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Scout: May be set aside before deployment. After all other units are deployed, may be deployed anywhere fully within 9" of their deployment zone, over 9" away from non-Scout enemy units. Players alternate in placing Scout units, starting with the player that activates next.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Scout Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Scout. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Screened: If most models in this unit have this rule, enemy units shooting/charging them from over 9"/6" away get -1 to hit rolls .
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Scurry: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Sergeant: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Shadowborn: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting/charging, that enemy unit gets -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6".
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Sharpshooter: Once per game, the Hero gets +12" range when shooting.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Shatter: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+3).
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Shielded: Units where most models have this rule get +1 to Defense rolls against hits that are not from spells.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Shielded Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Shielded. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Shred: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Shred in Melee Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Shred on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Shred when Shooting Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Shred on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Shrouded: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting/charging, that enemy unit gets -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6".
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Slayer: When using Hold actions and shooting, or when charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Slayer Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Slayer against once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Slow: Moves -2" when using Advance, and -4" when using Rush/Charge.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Smash: When attacking units over half of this weapon's range away, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Spawn: Once per game, when this model is activated, you may place a new unit of X fully within 6" of it. Units placed via Spawn can't seize or contest objectives on the round they are placed.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Specialist: Gets +1 to hit rolls when in melee or when shooting (pick one).
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Speed Debuff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy model within 18" in line of sight, which moves -2" when using Advance actions and -4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Speed Feat: Once per game, when this unit moves, you may use this rule so that all models with this rule in it move +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Speed Feat Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Speed Feat. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Spell Accumulator: Gets X accumulator tokens at the start of each round, but can't hold more than 6 tokens at once. Casters from other friendly units within 12" may spend this model's accumulator tokens as if they were their own spell tokens. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Spell Conduit: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Spell Resistance: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. If the wound was from a spell, then it is ignored on a 2+. If the wound was not from a spell, then it is ignored on a 6+ instead.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Spell Resistance Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Spell Resistance. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Split: When this unit is fully destroyed, you may place a new unit of X fully within 6" of it before removing the last model. Units placed via Split can't seize or contest objectives on the round they are placed.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Steadfast: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Steadfast Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Steadfast. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Stealth: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Stealth Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Stealth. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Strategist: Once per game, the Hero may re-roll one roll of any kind when shooting.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Strider: May ignore the effects of Difficult terrain. This unit halves the number of dice it rolls when jumping (rounding up).
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Strider Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Strider. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Sturdy: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Defense rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Suppressor: The Hero gets AP(+1) when using Hold and shooting.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Surge: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Surge when Shooting Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Surge on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Surprise Attack: Counts as having Infiltrate. The first time this unit is activated, pick one enemy unit within 6" in line of sight, and roll X dice. For each 2+ it takes one hit with AP(1).
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Swift: This model may ignore the Slow rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Swift Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Swift. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Tactician: Once per game, the Hero may re-roll one roll of any kind in melee.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Takedown: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target for this weapon's attacks, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Takedown Strike: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to strike in melee, it may make X attacks at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Teleport: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Teleport Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Teleport. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Tenacious: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Defense rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Thrust: When charging, gets +1 to hit rolls and AP(+1) in melee.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Thrust in Melee Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Thrust on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Tough: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Transport: May transport up to X friendly models with Tough(3) or Heroes with up to Tough(18), and non-Heroes with up to Tough(9) which occupy 3 spaces each. Transports may deploy with units inside, and units may enter/exit by using any move action, getting within 2" to enter, and staying fully within 6" when exiting. Units inside/outside transports may not target other units that are outside/inside, but may target the transport itself. When a transport is destroyed, units inside must take a Dangerous Terrain Test, are Shaken, and must be placed fully within 6" of the transport before it's removed.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Traversal: May move through friendly and enemy units.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Union Assault: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Unique Hero: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Unpredictable: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Unpredictable Fighter: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Unpredictable Fighter Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unpredictable Fighter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Unpredictable Fighter Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unpredictable Fighter against once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Unpredictable Shooter: When shooting, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Unpredictable Shooter Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unpredictable Shooter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Unstoppable: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Unstoppable in Melee Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unstoppable on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Unstoppable when Shooting Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unstoppable on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Vale Oath: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Valiant: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Morale Test rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Vanguard: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Vengeance: When this unit is fully destroyed, place as many Vengeance tokens on the unit that destroyed it as models with this rule in this unit at the beginning of the game. Friendly units get +X to hit rolls when attacking that unit, where X is the number of tokens on it.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Versatile Defense: When a unit where most models have this rule is shot/charged from over 9"/6" away, pick one effect: the unit either gets +1 to Defense rolls, or enemy units get -1 to hit rolls against it. Note that you may pick a different effect each time the unit is attacked.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Versatile Defense Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Versatile Defense. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Versatile Expert: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) when attacking, or get +1 to hit rolls when attacking.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Versatile Reach: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, all models with this rule in this unit either get +4" range when shooting or move +2" when charging.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Versatile Warrior: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away, all models with this rule in it either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Versatile Warrior Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Versatile Warrior. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Versatile Warrior Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 friendly units within 12", which gets Versatile Warrior once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Vicious: When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Vigilant: Gets +1 to hit rolls when shooting.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Vinci Tech: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away, all models with this rule in it either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Violent: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified results of 1 to block hits from weapons deal 1 extra wound.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Warbound: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified results of 1 to block hits from weapons deal 1 extra wound.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Warden: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Warding: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. If the wound was from a spell, then it is ignored on a 2+. If the wound was not from a spell, and the unit was shot/charged from over 9"/6" away, then it is ignored on a 6+ instead.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Wave-Step: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3".
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Weakened: Gets -1 to Defense rolls when blocking hits.
age-of-fantasy-skirmish.Wild Veil: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting/charging, that enemy unit gets -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6".

age-of-fantasy-quest.AP: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Agile: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Aircraft: May only use Advance actions, moving in a straight line, and adding 30" to its total move (even if Shaken). Aircraft ignore all units and terrain when moving and stopping, can't seize or contest objectives, can't be charged, and units targeting them get -12" range and -1 to hit rolls.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Ambush: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be placed anywhere over 9" away from enemy units.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Ambush Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ambush. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Ambush Re-Deployment: Once per game, when a unit where all models have this rule ends its activation, you may immediately remove it from the table (dropping any objectives it might hold within 1"), and deploy it as if it had Ambush at the beginning of the next round.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Angelic Blessing: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. If the wound was from a spell, then it is ignored on a 2+. If the wound was not from a spell, and the unit was shot/charged from over 9"/6" away, then it is ignored on a 6+ instead.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Artillery: When this model uses Hold actions and shoots at enemies over 12" away, it gets +1 to hit rolls. If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they haven't moved during this round, enemy units shooting at them from over 12" away get -1 to hit rolls.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Assault: Counts as both a ranged weapon and a melee weapon.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Bane: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Bane Mark: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Bane on their weapons when attacking against once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy-quest.Bane in Melee: This model gets Bane on its weapons in melee.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Bane in Melee Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bane on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Bane when Shooting: This model gets Bane on its weapons when shooting.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Bane when Shooting Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bane on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Banner: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to Morale Test rolls triggered by shooting/melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Battle-Hardened: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Morale Test rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Bestial: When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Blast: Ignores cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X, where X is up to as many hits as enemy models in the target unit and within 3" of it. Hits must be split evenly between all enemy units within 3" of any model from the target (players pick how).
age-of-fantasy-quest.Bloodthirsty Fighter: For each unmodified roll of 1 that enemies roll when blocking hits from this model's weapons in melee, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn't apply to newly generated attacks.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Bounding: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".
age-of-fantasy-quest.Bounding Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bounding. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Brace: Enemies charging this unit get -X total Impact rolls, unless this unit is Fatigued.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Brace in Melee: This model gets Brace(1) on its weapons in melee.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Bravery: Units where most models have this rule get +1 to Morale Test rolls.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Bravery Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to Morale Test rolls. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Bravery Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 nearest friendly units within 12", which gets +1 to Morale Test rolls once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy-quest.Brutal: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).
age-of-fantasy-quest.Brute Courage: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Buccaneer: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model gets +1 to hit rolls.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Caster: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can't have more than 6 at once. Once per activation, before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell's value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Pick a target and roll one die, and on 4+ resolve the spell's effect. Heroes may spend any number of tokens/power before rolling to get +1 to the roll per token/power, or to give an enemy Caster within 18" -1 to their roll per token/power.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Caster Group: This model counts as having Caster(1).
age-of-fantasy-quest.Casting Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 12" with Caster, which gets +1 to casting rolls once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy-quest.Changebound: If most models in this unit have this rule, enemy units shooting/charging them from over 9"/6" away get -1 to hit rolls .
age-of-fantasy-quest.Counter: May strike first with this weapon when charged, unless this unit is Fatigued.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Counter in Melee: This model gets Counter on its weapons in melee.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Counter in Melee Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Counter on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Counter-Attack: May strike first when charged, unless this unit is Fatigued.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Crazed: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn't apply to newly generated attacks.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Crossing Attack: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Crossing Strike: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and attack it with this weapon as if it was shooting. This weapon may only be used in this way.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Cumbersome: May only use Hold or Advance actions, but can't shoot when moving.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Cursed Undead: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Dangerous Terrain Debuff: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Dangerous terrain once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy-quest.Deadly: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don't carry over to other models if the original target is killed.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Deathstrike: If this model is killed in melee, the attacking unit takes X hits.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Decimate: When attacking units with more than half of their total size or Tough value (for single-model units), the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Defense: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.
age-of-fantasy-quest.Defense Buff: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 friendly units within 12", which gets +1 to Defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy-quest.Defense Debuff: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to Defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply).
age-of-fantasy-quest.Defensive Frenzy: Place one marker on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of six markers. For every three markers all models with this rule in this unit get +1 to Defense rolls. All markers are removed once the next wave of reinforcements is deployed.
