grimdark-future-star-quest.Swift Buff: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 friendly units within 12", which gets Swift once (next time the effect would apply).
grimdark-future-star-quest.Takedown: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target for this weapon's attacks, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Takedown Shot: Once per game, when this model shoots, it may make X extra attacks against the target at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Takedown Strike: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to strike in melee, it may make X attacks at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Targeting Visor: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model gets +1 to hit rolls.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Teleport: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Teleport Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Teleport. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Thrust: When charging, gets +1 to hit rolls and AP(+1) in melee.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Thrust in Melee: This model gets Thrust on its weapons in melee.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Thrust in Melee Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Thrust on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Thrust in Melee Buff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 nearest friendly units within 12", which gets Thrust in Melee once (next time the effect would apply).
grimdark-future-star-quest.Tough: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).
grimdark-future-star-quest.Transport: May transport up to X friendly models with Tough(9) or Heroes with up to Tough(54), and non-Heroes with up to Tough(27) which occupy 3 spaces each. Transports may deploy with units inside, and units may enter/exit by using any move action, getting within 2" to enter, and staying fully within 6" when exiting. Units inside/outside transports may not target other units that are outside/inside, but may target the transport itself. When a transport is destroyed, units inside must take a Dangerous Terrain Test, are Shaken, and must be placed fully within 6" of the transport before it's removed.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Union Assault: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Unique Hero: This hero may only be taken once per party.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Unpredictable: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Unpredictable Fighter: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Unpredictable Fighter Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unpredictable Fighter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Unpredictable Fighter Mark: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unpredictable Fighter against once (next time the effect would apply).
grimdark-future-star-quest.Unpredictable Shooter: When shooting, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Unpredictable Shooter Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unpredictable Shooter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Unpredictable Shooter Mark: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unpredictable Shooter against once (next time the effect would apply).
grimdark-future-star-quest.Unstoppable: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Unstoppable Mark: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unstoppable on their weapons against once (next time the effect would apply).
grimdark-future-star-quest.Unstoppable in Melee: This model gets Unstoppable on its weapons in melee.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Unstoppable in Melee Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unstoppable on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Unstoppable when Shooting: This model gets Unstoppable on its weapons when shooting.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Unstoppable when Shooting Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unstoppable on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Unwieldy Debuff: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which gets Unwieldy on its weapons in melee once (next time the effect would apply).
grimdark-future-star-quest.Valiant: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Morale Test rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Vanguard: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Vengeance: When this Hero becomes unconscious, place one Vengeance marker on the unit that made it unconscious. Friendly units get +X to hit rolls with their weapons when attacking that unit, where X is the number of markers on it.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Versatile Defense: When a unit where most models have this rule is shot/charged from over 9"/6" away, pick one effect: the unit either gets +1 to Defense rolls, or enemy units get -1 to hit rolls against it. Note that you may pick a different effect each time the unit is attacked.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Versatile Defense Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Versatile Defense. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Versatile Expert: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) when attacking, or get +1 to hit rolls when attacking.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Versatile Reach: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, all models with this rule in this unit either get +4" range when shooting or move +2" when charging.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Versatile Reach Aura: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Versatile Reach. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Versatile Warrior: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away, all models with this rule in it either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Vicious: When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Violent: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified results of 1 to block hits from weapons deal 1 extra wound.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Warbound: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified results of 1 to block hits from weapons deal 1 extra wound.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Warding: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. If the wound was from a spell, then it is ignored on a 2+. If the wound was not from a spell, and the unit was shot/charged from over 9"/6" away, then it is ignored on a 6+ instead.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Watchborn: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away, all models with this rule in it either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls.
grimdark-future-star-quest.Wolfborn: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3".
